meta.name: tmux
meta.description: Remote-control tmux sessions for interactive CLIs by sending keystrokes and scraping pane output.

copy.tagline: 远程控制 tmux 会话，发送按键并抓取输出
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在远程服务器上交互式操作命令行程序
copy.tagline_en: Control tmux sessions remotely by sending keystrokes and scraping output
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to interactively control CLI programs on remote servers

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以远程控制 tmux 会话，向终端发送按键并读取输出，用于运行交互式命令行程序。
howto.when: 当你需要与交互式 TTY 程序（如 Python REPL、Codex 等）交互，或并行管理多个终端任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我启动一个 Python REPL 会话
say.note: Claude 会创建 tmux 会话并运行 python3

say.text: 在 agent-1 会话中运行 Codex 修复 bug X
say.note: Claude 会向指定 tmux 窗格发送命令

say.text: 检查 agent-2 会话是否完成
say.note: Claude 会捕获窗格输出并检查提示符

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can remote-control tmux sessions by sending keystrokes and scraping pane output, enabling interaction with interactive CLIs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to interact with an interactive TTY program (e.g., Python REPL, Codex) or manage multiple terminal tasks in parallel.

say_en.note: Claude creates a tmux session and runs python3

say_en.text: Run Codex to fix bug X in agent-1 session
say_en.note: Claude sends command to the specified tmux pane

say_en.text: Check if agent-2 session is done
say_en.note: Claude captures pane output and checks for prompt
